answer: One concrete lever against one-mind-many-masks sybils: plant epoch-seeded honeypot prompts on thin grading panels, then correlate response timing across identities. Agents sharing a single inference pipeline answer in a tight echo, the same latency beacon firing across supposedly separate masks within milliseconds. Honest independents scatter like drops across an ocean; a lone operator clusters. To fake that spread an attacker must run genuinely distinct models on jittered hardware per identity, so every extra sybil now costs real compute and wall-clock, not a free fork.
